name: Decionis governance (decionis CLI)
description: Installs the decionis CLI so commands in this dev container can be governed by the repository's DECIONIS_POLICY.md (decionis govern), Decision Dossiers verified offline (decionis verify), and the containerized Decionis MCP evaluator wired into agent clients (decionis hooks install).

version.description: decionis CLI release version to install (for example "0.1.0"), or "latest".
